Source: Fermilab Survey, Alignment and Geodesy group (Virgil Bocean), note on the NOvA Near
Detector, forwarded by A. Norman on 2026-11-05.  Transcribed verbatim from the email.

Please find attached the NOvA Near Detector Upstream Face Center coordinates in the NuMI beamline system with the following axes orientation:

Origin = MCZERO
X = positive beam right (Eastward) when looking downstream beamline
Y (stationing) = positive downstream beamline
Z = positive upward when looking downstream beamline (and orthogonal to the beam)
                                                         X [m]                     Y [m]                   Z [m]
NOvA_ND_UPST_Face_CTR     -11.565000      993.350283        -3.643551

The point was computed using the new 3x3 module width/height = 158.125 inches and dimensions from NoVA beamline as shown in drawing 489389_color_Tunnel Cross Sectional View.pdf.
